The velvet cushion was already refunded for BRL 99.90 to the order’s original payment, receipt **R-H426-0001**. It cannot be refunded again or combined into a new refund. (refund-policy/v2/remaining) (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Refunds cannot be sent to your new MasterCard—only to the original payment. The woven throw blanket’s BRL 79.90 could be requested separately to that payment, but since you’ve declined that option, I haven’t created a proposal. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/amount)
